findings.label: Mobile menu incomplete
findings.description: B-42 mentions a 'hamburger slide-over' in the verification note as potentially missing, but the current header uses responsive component visibility rather than an explicit mobile menu component. The header successfully hides/shows elements via Tailwind breakpoints. This is functionally correct for mobile UX but differs from the 'more comprehensive mobile menu' pattern the note suggested. Acceptable as implemented since all navigation is accessible on mobile.

findings.label: SignIn route mismatch
findings.description: The ProtectedRoute redirects to `/signin`, but the App.tsx router also handles `/login` as the primary auth entry. The Auth flow should consistently use one primary route to avoid confusion. Currently both work, but UX would be clearer with unified terminology.
